goal: Write the simple part of a JSON Schema validator for draft 2020-12 (no $ref, no applicators such as allOf or properties) in plain Node.js (CommonJS, no packages). work/validate.js must export validate(schema, data, externalSchemas) returning true or false; externalSchemas maps URIs to schemas that $ref may point to. Every task is judged by the official JSON Schema Test Suite. The official tests are in tests-official/ for reading (a copy: the desk judges with its own). Several workers write in the same folder at once: agree on the structure through the files themselves (for example a README.md in work/ describing how keywords plug in) and do not break what others got accepted.
